chapters.title: Foreward
chapters.content:
# Foreward “There is no power for change greater than a community discovering what it cares about.” – Margaret J. Wheatley An Activity DAO is a decentralized community committed to ensuring an activity occurs and persists in a grassroots, decentralized manner.

❤️ Ethos

  • touch more grass
  • be with more people
  • fund activities as public goods
- do more dope things - be more active

chapters.title: 🔮 End Game
chapters.content:
## 🔮 End Game

⛹️‍♂️ End Game: Create community-run and funded ecosystems around every engaging activity

--- - Activities as public goods: self-sustaining with funding and proofing mechanisms that enable the growth of localized, interconnected communities - Foster high-quality, people-centric communities - Develop a model for the emergence of new activities and human interactions - Spark a renaissance of doing

Problem

- People are getting fatter and lonliner - Activities are defunded - People want to do cool things --- The problem of declining physical activity and social engagement among adults has become increasingly prevalent, leading to concerning health and social consequences. Here are the key facts that highlight the urgency of addressing this issue: 1. Obesity rates are projected to nearly double by 2035, reaching 1.53 billion adults[\[1\]](#fn1). 2. About one-third of American adults report feeling lonely at least weekly[\[2\]](#fn2). 3. Physical inactivity increases risks of heart disease, stroke, and certain cancers[\[3\]](#fn3). 4. Regular physical activity improves mental health, social skills, and overall well-being[\[4\]](#fn4)[\[3\]](#fn3).

Despite these clear benefits, many individuals face barriers to engaging in recreational activities and sports. Funding for community-based programs is often limited, and people struggle to find accessible, appealing options that fit their lifestyles. To address this problem, there is a pressing need for innovative funding mechanisms and community-driven initiatives that can: 1. Increase access to diverse, engaging recreational activities and sports programs. 2. Foster social connections and combat loneliness through group-based activities. 3. Promote the long-term health benefits of regular physical activity. 4. Leverage technology and modern trends to make activities more appealing and accessible to a wider audience. By focusing on these areas, we can create a targeted approach to encourage greater participation in recreational activities and sports, ultimately improving the physical, mental, and social well-being of adults in our communities. ---

chapters.title: What is An Activity DAO?
chapters.content:
# What is An Activity DAO? A DAO that mission is to make sure an activity gets done. ---

Ex;

- Pizza DAO makes sure Pizzas get eaten - BluntDAO makes sure Blunts get smoked - HoopsDAO makes sure people ball

Core: do activity

But to do activity you need enough to fund the activity and proof activity, with enhanced reputation for coordination.

chapters.title: Methodology
chapters.content: # Methodology - Let interest, funding, and coordination streamline into the best mechanism and roll out to proliferate this approach - Place people with appropriate interests and expertise to spin out activity DAOs - Future: Allow for customization for brands to spin out
